children: One Liberty Properties reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $26.6 million, up 11.9% year over year, while net income attributable to the company was $1.1 million. Diluted net income per share was $0.04, compared with $0.48 a year earlier, as the quarter included a much smaller gain on property sales. FFO per diluted share rose 7.1% to $0.45, and AFFO per diluted share increased 8.7% to $0.50.
Total revenue was $26.6 million, compared with $23.8 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Operating income was $8.2 million, down from $15.9 million a year earlier.
Net income attributable to One Liberty Properties was $1.1 million, versus $10.5 million; diluted net income per share was $0.04, compared with $0.48.
FFO was $9.9 million, or $0.45 per diluted share, up from $9.1 million, or $0.42 per share. AFFO was $11.0 million, or $0.50 per diluted share, compared with $10.1 million, or $0.46 per share.
Industrial properties accounted for approximately 86% of base rent, and portfolio occupancy was 97.5% at quarter end.
Acquired a 100,000-square-foot industrial building in Ocala, Florida, adding to the company’s Southeast presence.
Signed an agreement to acquire a four-building, 277,117-square-foot industrial portfolio in the Milwaukee area, with closing expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
Sold two non-core retail properties during the quarter and five properties, including two industrial and three retail assets, after quarter end as part of its capital-recycling strategy.
